what: Forest warden mini-boss: antlered humanoid in a leaf cloak carrying a glowing rune staff.

dims.basis: measured from exported GLB; 1.50x player including antlers, body ~2.2u

views.why: fought from the player's eye view; silhouette must read as a boss at once

style_notes: Low-Poly Diorama: chunky, faceted, flat-shaded, saturated accent colours, readable at ~60 px. Palette-only (docs/ART_DIRECTION.md), no textures, no smooth shading. 1 tile = 1 u; player = 1.55 u; storey = 2.5 u; doors 0.9 x 2.0 u. Base at z=0, centred on (0,0). Never: smooth normals, external textures, invented hues, hidden geometry nobody sees.
notes: Hero finishing: bevel on torso/staff/pauldrons/mask only, weighted normals, flat shading, smart UV pack; 450 tris. Branching skull-attached antlers and front-facing leaf cloak added after the first critic round.
